name: Azumi
source:
The high school nurse, married. Had a close relationship with [url=https://vndb.org/c104176]Izuku[/url], but after his disappearance, there is no information about her. She has a very kind, compassionate personality, although she likes to complain about others (in most cases righteously). Her husband spent all the money on Pachinko machines and ran away, which is why she is in debt to the Yakuza. If she doesn't repay the debt in 2 years, she will face irreparable consequences.

[In game description]
